response.sql:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MT.MediaTypeId,
    MT.Name,
    SUM(T.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(T.Milliseconds) AS rate,
    COUNT(T.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType MT
  JOIN Track T ON MT.MediaTypeId = T.MediaTypeId
  WHERE T.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MT.MediaTypeId, MT.Name
),
average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT
  mts.Name,
  mts.rate,
  mts.track_count,
  mts.rate - ar.avg_rate AS above_average
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN average_rate ar
WHERE mts.rate > ar.avg_rate
ORDER BY mts.rate DESC

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from calculations, as a bytes-per-millisecond rate cannot be computed without a Bytes value.
Each media type's rate is the aggregate ratio SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) rather than the average of individual per-track rates.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate each media type's rate as the average of its per-track bytes-per-millisecond values, treating each track equally: AVG(Bytes / Milliseconds).

  FROM MediaType MT

  WHERE T.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MT.MediaTypeId, MT.Name

average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT
  mts.Name,
  mts.rate,
  mts.track_count,
  mts.rate - ar.avg_rate AS above_average
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN average_rate ar
WHERE mts.rate > ar.avg_rate
ORDER BY mts.rate DESC
